title: French family benefits, household amount regime for two children by residence, resources, each child's age, earnings and care arrangement (InterfaceAllocationsFamiliales, 2020-05-01)

attributes.name: residence
attributes.source: InterfaceAllocationsFamiliales input i_résidence (epilogue.catala_fr:79), type France.Collectivité (prologue_france/France.catala_fr:9-18); labels are the ASCII constructor names of the generated Python

attributes.name: ressources
attributes.source: i_ressources_ménage (epilogue.catala_fr:78), euros per year. plafond_I_d521_3 = 57 759 € + 5 775 € × n and plafond_II_d521_3 = 80 831 € + 5 775 € × n for 2020 (decrets_divers.catala_fr:101-122), n = number of children with droit_ouvert; compared in D521-1 (securite_sociale_D.catala_fr:35, 58, 77-78, 102-103, 120, 142). Representatives in euros; plafond_I(n), plafond_II(n) and the midpoint (rounded down to the euro) depend on n, see CONVERSION.md

attributes.name: enfant1_age

a03_11.predicate: date_de_naissance + 3 an < date_courante and date_de_naissance + 11 an > date_courante

a11_14.predicate: date_de_naissance + 11 an <= date_courante and date_de_naissance + 14 an > date_courante

a14_16.predicate: date_de_naissance + 14 an <= date_courante and date_de_naissance + 16 an >= date_courante

a16_19.predicate: date_de_naissance + 16 an < date_courante and (date_de_naissance + 20 an) - date_courante >= 365 jour

a19_20.predicate: (date_de_naissance + 20 an) - date_courante < 365 jour and date_de_naissance + 20 an > date_courante

attributes.source: d_date_de_naissance of EnfantEntrée (epilogue.catala_fr:68); representative = birth date of slot 1 (slot k: plus k-1 days) at date_courante 2020-05-01. Thresholds: 3 an and 16 an (obligation_scolaire, epilogue.catala_fr:123, 127), 11 an (D755-5, securite_sociale_D.catala_fr:419-420), 14 an (majoration L521-3 with R521-1, securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:315-321, securite_sociale_R.catala_fr:54), 20 an minus 365 jour (allocation forfaitaire L521-1, securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:146-152), 20 an (L512-3 2°, securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:71; R512-2, securite_sociale_R.catala_fr:21)

attributes.name: enfant1_remuneration
attributes.source: d_rémuneration_mensuelle (epilogue.catala_fr:67), euros per month; plafond_l512_3_2 = (smic.brut_horaire * 55%) * 169,0 (securite_sociale_R.catala_fr:29-31, 218-223) = 943,02 € (Mayotte 711,49 €) at 2020-05-01 after the runtime's rounding; compared with <= (securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:70, 83)

attributes.name: enfant1_prise_en_charge
attributes.source: d_prise_en_charge (epilogue.catala_fr:69), type PriseEnCharge (prologue.catala_fr:10-15); read by L521-2 prise_en_compte / versement (securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:186-280)

output.name: regime_montant_verse
output.source: Derived from i_montant_versé (epilogue.catala_fr:80, 90; montant_versé epilogue.catala_fr:45-52): zero = 0 €; otherwise the statutory amount regime: mayotte (résidence Mayotte, Décret n°2002-423 art. 7, decrets_divers.catala_fr:170-215), outre_mer_1_enfant (L751-1 residence and exactly one child with droit_ouvert: L755-12 securite_sociale_L.catala_fr:436-466, D755-5 securite_sociale_D.catala_fr:382-404), general_t1/t2/t3 (L521-1 and D521-1: resources <= plafond I, <= plafond II, above, securite_sociale_D.catala_fr:35-142). See CONVERSION.md

date_courante.why: date of 7 of the 14 household tests (Test1-Test6, Test9); every date-dependent parameter (SMIC 2020, BMAF 414,4 € from 2020-04-01, household ceilings 2020, Mayotte rates 2020) is constant on [2020-04-01, 2020-12-31]

child_slots.why: number of child slots of the table; children of a row are the present slots in slot order

identifiants.why: d_identifiant is read only through the record equality of EnfantLePlusÂgé (epilogue.catala_fr:11-23, 33-35); distinct values keep two children with the same birth date distinct

est_parent.label: true
est_parent.why: set by every official household test; the parent conditions vary in FR-AF-1

titre_I.label: false
titre_I.why: left at its default by every official household test; varies in FR-AF-1

avait_enfant_avant_2012.label: false
avait_enfant_avant_2012.why: left at its default by 13 of 14 official household tests; varies in FR-AF-1

enfant_deja_ouvert.label: true
enfant_deja_ouvert.why: vrai for every official test child; varies in FR-AF-3

enfant_apl.label: false
enfant_apl.why: faux for every official test child; varies in FR-AF-3

notes: Households of exactly two children. Care arrangement and earnings vary per child. See CONVERSION.md.
